resources.string: On in the main shell. Paused in full-screen apps and Zellij. Only the current unsent token is editable. Disable before secrets. enforce-char-based-input takes precedence.

Your keyboard sees typed input. Termux-Avic requests no personalized learning; the keyboard may ignore that request. Terminal output and history are never supplied to the keyboard.

Check suggested commands before pressing Enter. Only the current unsent token can be corrected. Letters wait for a space, punctuation, Enter, or control action. Predictions pause in full-screen apps and Zellij, including shell panes, then resume on exit. Disable this mode before passwords, tokens, private commands, or apps needing immediate characters in the main shell. The local preview can appear even when a program turns echo off.

The enforce-char-based-input property still takes precedence. Changes apply when you return to the terminal; termux-reload-settings also works.
